models_providers_subscriptions_forwarded: Subscriptions are only forwarded while this provider connects directly to

models_providers_max_retries_help: Retries use exponential backoff. After the last retry, the request falls back to any fallback models it names.
models_providers_concurrency_help: Maximum in-flight requests to this provider.
models_providers_queue_size_help: Requests waiting for a free worker.
models_providers_queue_size_too_small: Queue size must be at least the concurrency.
models_providers_models_appear_suffix: page, where access policies decide who can use them.
models_providers_delete_provider_confirm: Delete {name} and all of its keys? Its models will no longer be available.

models_status_failed_to_start: The LLM gateway failed to start: {error}
models_status_no_providers: No upstream providers are configured yet.
models_budgets_details_description: A budget applies to everyone in its profile. It either gives each of them their own allowance or is one pool they share.
models_budgets_scope_per_user: Each of the profile's users gets these limits individually
models_budgets_scope_shared: One pool shared by all of the profile's users
models_budgets_stacking_note: A budget covers this profile's models. When several profiles' budgets cover the same model, the tightest one limits it.
models_budgets_user_token_limits: Users' personal daily token limits replace this budget's token limits
models_budgets_limits_description: Requests are rejected once any limit is reached. Rolling windows free up as usage ages out; calendar windows reset at the start of the hour, day, week or month (UTC).
models_budgets_models_description: Choose which of this profile's models count against this budget.
models_budgets_no_profile_models: This profile doesn't grant any models.
models_budgets_current_usage_description: Usage in each limit's current window.
models_budgets_no_usage: No usage in the current window.
models_guardrail_policies_var_params: Request parameters; currently only params.max_tokens, when the request sets it
models_guardrail_policies_var_user: Caller, with user.id and user.groups (the IDs of their auth provider groups)
models_guardrail_policies_input_scope_la: Only new messages since the last response
models_guardrail_policies_details_descri: What this applied guardrail checks in model requests and responses, and what happens when one of its guardrails finds something.
models_guardrail_policies_apply_to_descr: Input is the prompt sent to the model; output is its response, including streams.
models_guardrail_policies_action_block_d: Rejects the request or response when any guardrail finds a problem.
models_guardrail_policies_action_redact_: Masks what the guardrails find and lets the rest through.
models_guardrail_policies_action_log_des: Lets the traffic through and records the finding in the LLM audit log.
models_guardrail_policies_sampling_rate_: Percentage of matching traffic that is checked.
models_guardrail_policies_fail_closed: Fail closed: block when a guardrail can't be evaluated
models_guardrail_policies_block_message_: Leave empty for the default message
models_guardrail_policies_guardrails_des: The checks it runs. Any finding from any selected guardrail triggers the action.
models_guardrail_policies_non_redacting_: {names} uses a provider that can't locate findings for redaction. Findings from it will block instead.
{names} use providers that can't locate findings for redaction. Findings from them will block instead.
models_guardrail_policies_condition_desc: expression. The guardrails only apply when it is true. Leave empty to apply to all matching traffic.
models_profiles_empty_description: A profile gives users and groups models, and applies budgets and guardrails to them. Users who aren't in any profile can't use any model.
models_profiles_intro: Profiles add up: a user in several profiles can use the models of each, and the budgets and applied guardrails of each apply to them.
models_profiles_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Its budgets and applied guardrails are deleted with it, and its users lose the models it gives them.
models_profiles_delete_confirm_unnamed: Delete this profile? Its budgets and applied guardrails are deleted with it, and its users lose the models it gives them.
models_profiles_budgets_description: Caps on spend, tokens or requests for this profile's users. Every budget that applies to a user must have room, including those of their other profiles.
models_profiles_budgets_empty: No budgets. This profile doesn't limit its users' usage.
models_profiles_budgets_no_models: Add models to this profile for its budgets to apply.
models_routing_empty_description: Requests go to the provider and model they name. Add a rule to redirect, split or fail over traffic.
models_routing_enabled_hint: When off, this rule doesn't route any requests.
models_routing_var_model: Requested model name, without the provider prefix (e.g. gpt-4o)
models_routing_var_headers: Request headers, by lowercase name (e.g. headers["x-tier"])
models_routing_var_request_type: API called: chat_completion, responses (also Anthropic Messages) or embedding, with _stream added for streaming requests
models_routing_evaluation_order: Rules are evaluated in priority order.
models_routing_ttft_help: Optional time to first token timeout, in seconds: a streaming request that gets no first token from the target in time moves on to the next fallback. Leave empty for no timeout.
models_routing_ttft_invalid: Time to first token timeouts must be between 0.001 and {max} seconds.
models_routing_fallbacks_help: Tried in order when the target fails after its retries.
models_routing_ttft_needs_fallback: A time to first token timeout only takes effect when there is a fallback to move on to, from this rule or the request.
models_settings_traffic_description: How the gateway limits requests and handles overload. Requests are recorded in the LLM audit log and usage reports.
models_settings_drop_excess: Reject requests when a provider is at capacity
models_settings_drop_excess_help: Each provider handles a set number of requests at once and holds more in line (Concurrency and Queue size on the provider's page). When that line is full: off, new requests wait for room; on, they fail right away with a 503 so clients can retry elsewhere.
models_budgets_all_models_description: Requests for any of this profile's models count against this budget.
models_budgets_specific_models_descripti: Only requests for the models you select count against this budget.
models_budgets_limit_invalid: Enter a limit of 0 or more.
models_budgets_enabled_hint: When off, this budget isn't enforced and requests don't count against it.
models_guardrail_policies_enabled_hint: When off, this applied guardrail doesn't check any traffic.

models_profile_form_description: A profile gives its users and groups models, and applies its budgets and guardrails to them.
models_profile_users_description: The users and groups this profile applies to.
models_profile_models_description: The models this profile's users can use.
models_profiles_applied_guardrails_descr: Checks on this profile's model requests and responses, which block, redact or log what their guardrails find. The applied guardrails of every profile a user is in apply.
models_profiles_applied_guardrails_empty: No applied guardrails. This profile adds no checks on its users' requests.
